headline_scope.description: Current crown representatives contribute one set of service estimates per crown. Lower vegetation and hidden earlier unmatched detections are excluded. assembly.note: Package links verified against the V5.1 release; SQL-regenerated linked records, hash-verified unchanged profiles and geometry; rebuilt map, property summaries, totals and KYTE nearby choices.

v5_changes: All 3,149 survey tiles completed successfully, including 16 retries.
V5 crown dimensions use 2024 point-cloud structure and aerial NDVI.
Every previous ALTO tree ID remains available. Current representatives link to original source records.
Crown identity uses actual containment and polygon intersection; shared crowns can contain several trees.
Unverified notable-tree positions are excluded from automatic crown attachment. Council renumbering has a versioned crosswalk.
Existing service and trunk sensitivity equations use the new crown dimensions once per representative. Earlier estimates remain in the full records.
Lower vegetation is available as separate layers and excluded from tree service totals.
Earlier crown outlines are retained outside the new survey footprint.
KYTE nearby matching uses the same current representatives. Saved observations and original IDs remain valid.
limitations_v5: Segmentation changes are not tree removals or growth observations.
A crown can contain more than one tree, and a multi-stem tree can remain split.
Three polygon validity repairs and four area corrections are logged; original outputs are preserved.
Growth-form predictions and historical matching were not refitted on v5 crowns.
The earlier fitted forecast is applied to current crown height; its original benchmark does not validate this transfer. Nearby-history weighting awaits refreshed spatial matching.
The service, DBH and root coefficients remain sensitivity assumptions requiring field calibration.
Summed crown areas include overlaps and are not a measure of land-cover percentage.
v51_changes: Restored 4,661 crown associations across 4,362 existing crowns: 3,518 Auckland Transport, 470 Council Parks and 673 earlier LiDAR records.
Retained all 6,238,420 original source IDs, source positions and existing survey histories. Former generated representatives remain accessible as linked records.
Recomputed affected model scenarios once per representative crown using the existing V5 equations; no recalibration or new ground measurements.
Rebuilt map markers, property summaries, release totals and KYTE nearby suggestions from the same repaired snapshot.
Preserved the two KYTE visits already accepted since V5. Incoming submissions and researcher review decisions were not changed.
Crown unlinked replaces No crown: failure to link a source position does not establish tree absence.
v51_limits: The V5 polygon geometry, including known holes and clipped boundaries, is unchanged.
28,735 audited candidates still need review; proximity alone is not sufficient for automatic attachment.
A restored crown association does not certify that every linked source record describes the same organism.
The private researcher workbench retains its earlier dataset baseline and saved assessments until a separate, versioned migration.
v52_changes: Joined 3,088 records that V5.1 left unlinked to a crown: 1,043 linked and 1,456 probable matches to existing V5 crowns, and 589 on 534 crowns drawn from the 2024 returns at the record position.
1,456 crowns are now represented by a register or other source record instead of a LiDAR detection; 844 records joined a tree that already had a marker and are listed in its profile.

A protected or notable tree never loses its marker: 1 protected record now represents its crown in place of an ordinary record, and 14 protected records on a crown already represented by a protected tree keep their own marker; estimates are counted once per crown. Protected trees on the map: 3,570 (V5.1 3,570).
Record-seeded crowns are drawn faintly and await confirmation. 457 are counted in totals and services with a flag (crown_source record_seeded_v52); 77 are 2–3 m and follow the low-canopy rule.
A new default-off layer, Council recorded positions, shows each joined record's original source point and a line to its crown top. Source coordinates are unchanged in the full record.
Recomputed service scenarios once per representative crown with the existing V5 equations; superseded representative estimates are archived in the release database.
Retained all 6,238,420 original source IDs, positions and histories, the V5.1 continuity repair, the two accepted KYTE visits and all researcher review decisions.
v52_limits: Precision by class: linked 0.989 hold-out, 47/48 blind audit; probable 0.936, 33/37; drawn from the record 31/37 audit only. Audit intervals are wide.

20,704 records went to researcher review and are unchanged on the map, and the drawn-crown links await confirmation there; 13,613 records outside V5 and 2024 point-cloud coverage stay unlinked with that reason.
4 drawn-crown links were excluded because their crown enclosed an existing V5 crown; those records are unchanged.
V5 polygon geometry, including known holes and clipped boundaries, is unchanged. Record-seeded crowns are proposals until confirmed.
A link does not certify that every record on a shared crown describes the same organism.
v6_changes: Growth form for 3,352,099 crowns: 2,771,551 shown, 580,548 not yet determined. Every shown growth form is a model estimate; recorded species stay the species shown.
Crowns are drawn with smoothed outlines of the same V5 cells (area preserved); V5.2 record-seeded crowns smoothed the same way.

Service estimates changed for 2,918,424 representatives (PHASE2_DECISION 13.9): reweighted by the growth-form probabilities where a call is shown (2,749,679), the flagged evergreen default where it is not (168,745, previously the legacy image-model class). Recorded species keep their estimates.
Display rules: r15 with the V2 palm guard (1,028 crowns), palm-type medium calls outside the isthmus shown as "possibly" (0), deciduous worded by flight date (late June from day 166).
Retained every V5.2 record, link, marker, source position, history, review decision, accepted KYTE visit, V5 growth-form field and service row (in the database).
v6_limits: Growth form is a coarse class, not a species. Shown calls were about 94% right on the 600-crown blind test outside the isthmus (design-weighted); conifer and palm-type cells rest on small samples.
Tree fern uses the V5 palm leaf area and trunk curve until a tree-fern value is chosen.
Crowns drawn from a record in V5.2, crowns outside the V5 survey and records without a crown have no growth-form estimate.
Outlines smooth the V5 cells; V5 crown boundaries and sizes are otherwise unchanged (crowns over 60 m² remain about 20% smaller than human outlines).

corrections.note: Reviewer corrections from config/corrections/corrections.jsonl applied after the build (corrections_v6.py).
